newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine deputies delay budget reading to Friday.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine deputies delay budget reading to Friday.

text.p: Parliament in Ukraine delayed a third and final reading of this year's much-delayed budget which had been expected to take place late on Thursday to June 27.
Speaker Olexander Moroz had earlier asked deputies to pass the draft on Thursday but pre-voting debates dragged on and eventually the chamber agreed to reconvene in the morning.
Moroz asked deputies to read the draft and be ready for a final budget session on Friday from 10 a.m. (0800 GMT).
The budget is key among conditions Ukraine must meet for a $2.5 to $3 billion International Monetary Fund loan.
It was first passed in December but returned to government for amendments and has been in legislative limbo ever since.
But deputies stayed in session until late on Wednesday, getting through the bulk of the draft at a second reading.
